cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Credit for the Impossible
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you understood, predicted, or accepted the impossible truth before anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I drew that floating staircase last week. Mention the date.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can all see it now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I drew the handrail while you called it nonsense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Loud enough for the people using my prediction to get upstairs.
